'''''Splinter''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that saw service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The ''Splinter'' participated in the [[mission at Argoon]] and was destroyed in the battle.
